title: AI SOP Builder
summary: Convert existing documents, videos, and staff notes into structured standard operating procedures your team can follow.
businessProblem: Critical processes live in the owner's head or scattered across old PDFs. New hires learn by shadowing, mistakes repeat, and nothing is documented until something goes wrong.
outcome: Step-by-step SOPs with roles, tools, checkpoints, and common mistakes — published to your knowledge base from existing materials in hours, not weeks.
whoItsFor: Business owners with 3+ employees who need to document processes before scaling, franchising, or reducing key-person dependency.
aiInputs: Existing process documents (PDFs, Word docs, checklists)
Video or call transcripts of owner explaining a process
Staff notes describing how they actually do the task
SOP template structure (steps, roles, tools, checkpoints)
aiOutputs: Role assignments per step (who does what)
noCodeTools: ChatGPT or Claude with document upload (manual per SOP)
Scribe or Tango for process recording + AI formatting
Notion AI to convert pasted notes into SOP format
lowCodeTools: n8n: new Drive file in SOP folder → OpenAI → Notion page created
TrainGPT or custom GPT on your SOP template
customBuildStack: Google Drive API to watch SOP input folder
Claude API for long-document SOP generation
Notion API to publish formatted SOP pages
implementationSteps: Define your SOP template: steps, roles, tools, checkpoints, common mistakes
Gather source materials for your first 3 processes
Upload to a dedicated Drive folder or paste into AI tool
Generate SOP drafts and review with the person who actually does the task
Publish approved SOPs to Notion or shared Drive
Set quarterly review reminder to flag outdated SOPs
systemBehavior: Triggered manually or when new file added to input folder
Generates draft SOP — never publishes without human review
Uses consistent template structure across all SOPs
Flags steps where source materials conflict or are ambiguous
Version-tracks SOPs when source documents update
risks: AI may omit safety-critical steps not mentioned in source materials
SOPs based on one person's method may not match how others work
Outdated SOPs are worse than none — review schedule is essential
Staff may follow incomplete SOPs without reporting gaps
